value: CHANNEL-9 EVENT ACCEPT: CURRENT LISTENER CLOSES BEFORE A LEGAL RETRY

The responder may legally defer an EVENT_ACCEPT anywhere inside its 6 s retry budget while existing Channel-9 ownership clears. A 1 s proposer listener therefore cannot cover the protocol it initiated; one 6 s listen does.
Use one shared bound: EVENT_ACCEPT listener duration >= EVENT_ACCEPT retry deadline. This removes repeated proposal cycles without adding a new queue or route-repair mechanism.
